ngram_overlap.method: Manual and script-ready review of task inputs across train/dev/held_out partitions
ngram_overlap.threshold: No held-out task should share 8-gram input overlap with train tasks
ngram_overlap.notes: Held-out tasks use distinct prospect scenarios and phrasing from train/dev starter tasks.

embedding_similarity.method: Planned embedding check using cosine similarity
embedding_similarity.notes: Interim dataset is small; full embedding check will be automated for the 200-300 task version.

time_shift_verification.threshold: Any public-data reference must include a documented signal window
time_shift_verification.notes: Current interim tasks are synthetic and seed-derived; no live public-data time-shift dependency is present.

generator_judge_separation.threshold: Do not use the same model family to generate and judge the same task
generator_judge_separation.notes: The interim evaluator is deterministic/rule-based, so model-family leakage is not yet present.

known_limitations: Embedding similarity check not automated yet
Held-out is not yet cryptographically sealed
Full multi-LLM generation logs not yet populated
